newsitem.title: UK: BT shares stumble on MCI deal worries. [CORRECTED 10:52 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BT shares stumble on MCI deal worries. [CORRECTED 10:52 GMT]

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc fell on Thursday as prospects of renegotiating a deal with MCI Communications Corp of the U.S. appeared to be fading, dealers said.
The shares were 6-1/2p weaker at 439 by 0817 GMT.
BT's planned $20 billion (corrects from millions) merger with MCI was rocked last week by an unexpected profits warning from the U.S. company.

Some analysts had suggested that the merger deal could be renegotiated in the wake of MCI's revelations. But after BT's annual meeting, the Daily Telegraph newspaper said BT had admitted it was "handcuffed" to the deal and could not make any changes to the terms.
Dealers said a growing conviction that a renegotiation was unlikely was hitting the shares.
"They're a bit weak today because of more worries about the MCI deal," one market-maker said. "It looks like they won't be able to make it any more favourable to themselves."
